pairs: Abraham vero aliam duxit uxorem nomine Ceturam:
In truth, Abraham took another wife, named Keturah.
And she bore to him Zimran,
The sons of Dedan were Asshurim,
At vero ex Madian ortus est Epha,
And truly, from Midian was born Ephah,
All these were the sons of Keturah.
Deditque Abraham cuncta quæ possederat, Isaac:
And Abraham gave everything that he possessed to Isaac.
filiis autem concubinarum largitus est munera,
But to the sons of the concubines he gave generous gifts,
et separavit eos ab Isaac filio suo,
and he separated them from his son Isaac,
Now the days of Abraham’s life were one hundred
Et deficiens mortuus est in senectute bona,
And declining, he died in a good old age,
and at an advanced stage of life, and full of days.
And he was gathered to his people.
And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the double cave,
et Ismaël filii sui in spelunca duplici,
which was situated in the field of Ephron,
quæ sita est in agro Ephron filii Seor Hethæi,
of the son of Zohar the Hittite,
across from the region of Mamre,
which he had bought from the sons of Heth.
Et post obitum illius benedixit Deus Isaac filio ejus,
qui habitabat juxta puteum nomine Viventis
who lived near the well named ‘of the One who lives and who sees.’
Hæ sunt generationes Ismaël filii Abrahæ,
These are the generations of Ishmael, the son of Abraham,
whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant,
hæc nomina filiorum ejus in vocabulis et generationibus suis.
And these are the names of his sons according to their language and generations.
The firstborn of Ishmael was Nebaioth,
These are the sons of Ishmael.
et hæc nomina per castella et oppida eorum,
And these are their names throughout their fortresses and towns:
the twelve princes of their tribes.
Et facti sunt anni vitæ Ismaëlis centum triginta septem,
And the years of the life of Ishmael that passed were one hundred and thirty-seven.
he died and was placed with his people.
Habitavit autem ab Hevila usque Sur,
Now he had lived from Havilah as far as Shur,
which overlooks Egypt as it approaches the Assyrians.
He passed away in the sight of all his brothers.
Hæ quoque sunt generationes Isaac filii Abraham:
Likewise, these are the generations of Isaac, the son of Abraham.
who, when he was forty years old, took Rebekah,
duxit uxorem Rebeccam filiam Bathuelis Syri de Mesopotamia,
the sister of Laban, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian from Mesopotamia,
Deprecatusque est Isaac Dominum pro uxore sua,
And Isaac beseeched the Lord on behalf of his wife,
and he gave conception to Rebekah.
Sed collidebantur in utero ejus parvuli;
But the little ones struggled in her womb.
“If it was to be so with me,
what need was there to conceive?”
And she went to consult the Lord.
Duæ gentes sunt in utero tuo,
et duo populi ex ventre tuo dividentur,
and two peoples will be divided out of your womb,
and one people will overcome the other people,
and the elder will serve the younger.”
Now the time had arrived to give birth,
et ecce gemini in utero ejus reperti sunt.
and behold, twins were discovered in her womb.
Qui prior egressus est, rufus erat,
He who departed first was red,
et totus in morem pellis hispidus:
and entirely hairy like a pelt;
and his name was called Esau.
Protinus alter egrediens, plantam fratris tenebat manu:
At once the other departed and he held his brother’s foot in his hand;
and because of this he was called Jacob.
Sexagenarius erat Isaac quando nati sunt ei parvuli.
Isaac was sixty years old when the little ones were born to him.
factus est Esau vir gnarus venandi, et homo agricola:
Esau became a knowledgeable hunter and a man of agriculture,
Jacob autem vir simplex habitabat in tabernaculis.
but Jacob, a simple man, dwelt in tents.
eo quod de venationibus illius vesceretur:
because he was fed from his hunting;
Then Jacob boiled a small meal.
ad quem cum venisset Esau de agro lassus,
Esau, when he had arrived weary from the field,
ait: Da mihi de coctione hac rufa,
said to him, “Give me this red stew,
Quam ob causam vocatum est nomen ejus Edom.
For this reason, his name was called Edom.
“Sell me your right of the firstborn.”
what will the right of the firstborn provide for me?”
Juravit ei Esau et vendidit primogenita.
Esau swore to him, and he sold his right of the firstborn.
taking bread and the food of lentils,
giving little weight to having sold the right of the firstborn.
